name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 24 – Am 14
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 24b. Expresses deep concern about the lack of transparency of NGOs, especially regarding their funding; recalls the findings of European Court of Auditors (ECA) special report 35/2018, which highlighted the lack of transparency regarding the implementation of EU funds by NGOs; emphasises the consequent risk of money laundering and terrorist financing through non-profit organisations; recalls ECA special report 11/2025, which showed that, of more than 4 400 NGOs, 30 received more than 40 % of total funding (i.e. EUR 3.3 billion) during the period 2014-2023, and linked this to the intravenous dependence of certain NGOs on EU funding, with all that this ultimately implies for their activities and orientations;
